notes: Every jobhunter automation (design 10.3 step 13; CLI route 6.3). Agent jobs always carry an explicit tools list (restricted runs; never * or absent) and end their message with the single final word the run must reply with (CYCLE_DONE, PROBE_DONE, ONBOARD_DONE), never NO_REPLY. purpose: lane jobs are started by the dispatcher; onboarding and probe jobs only by ./jobhunter and install.sh through jh.py install run-preflight; agent-oneshot is not created by install: its spec is written to the install manifest and used by the QC one-shot runs. Placeholders: {PY}, {REPO}, {WS_ROOT}.

jobs.name: jobhunter-housekeeping
jobs.display: Job Hunter: nightly housekeeping and audit

jobs.name: jobhunter-scout
jobs.message: Run exactly one scout cycle as defined in AGENTS.md. First command: {PY} {REPO}/scripts/jh.py preflight --lane scout. When the cycle is over, reply with the single word CYCLE_DONE.

jobs.name: jobhunter-probe-scout
jobs.message: Tool check. Do exactly these steps and nothing else. 1. Run {PY} {REPO}/scripts/jh.py whoami with the exec tool. 2. Write the text OK to {WS_ROOT}/scout/work/probe/ok.txt with the write tool. 3. Read that file with the read tool. Then reply with the single word PROBE_DONE.
